extracted.intended_audience: national and county government officials; non-state actors (NSAs); development partners; civic education providers; agencies responsible for public participation in Kenya
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and apply the policy objectives and standards for designing, managing, resourcing, and evaluating public participation processes across national and county levels in Kenya.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will ensure citizens continually access timely information on public issues, in a language and format that is easy to understand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access to information is a constitutional right (Article 35(1)) operationalized through the Access to Information Act, 2016. Information must empower citizens and enable accountability; governments have obligation to disclose information through appropriate media and formats, particularly in areas with high illiteracy levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Formulate and review enabling policies and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Formulate and review the necessary policies, legislation and procedures necessary to make information available and accessible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative and procedural frameworks should be periodically reviewed to ensure availability and accessibility of information required for meaningful public participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Timely publication and appropriate media/formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure timely publication and dissemination of all information needed by the citizens for effective participation in a language(s) and media that are appropriate, including both official languages and in accessible formats for PWDs and the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid sole reliance on media unsuitable for low-literacy or low-circulation contexts (e.g., newspapers in some areas); materials should be accessible to persons with disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — User-friendly responsive information system
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a user-friendly system where information requested is provided in conformity with the Constitution and other applicable laws related to access to information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systems should enable citizens to request and receive information efficiently and legally, with clear procedures for requests and responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Lawful limitations on access
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure any limitation on access to information is in conformity with the Constitution and other laws related to access to information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where disclosure is limited for legitimate reasons (e.g., national security, privacy), limits must be legally grounded and proportionate; balance transparency with necessary confidentiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Collaborative information sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure a collaborative approach to information sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage inter-agency and government-NSA collaboration to publish and disseminate information coherently and reduce fragmentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information — Records management and integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that records are accurate, authentic, have integrity, are usable and recorded in a manner which facilitates the right of access to information in conformity with the Constitution and all other relevant laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good records management underpins access rights; records should be maintained to preserve authenticity, integrity and usability for public access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will provide the framework for coordination and enabling environment for NSAs involved in civic education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Civic education is prerequisite for effective participation; K-NICE is the national framework domiciled in the Attorney General’s Office and Department of Justice and should be leveraged for collaborative national civic education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Enact enabling policies and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Formulate, enact and implement the necessary policies, legislation and procedures for civic education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal and policy instruments should enable standardized, sustained civic education across national and county levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Customise curriculum collaboratively
rubrics_metrics.description: Customise curriculum for civic education for specific needs in collaboration with all actors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curricula should be tailored to local contexts, audiences, and needs and developed with input from government, NSAs, and other stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Mechanisms for minorities and marginalised groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish citizen education mechanisms for the minorities and marginalised groups in line with the Constitution and other related laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special measures are required to ensure civic education reaches rural areas, minorities and marginalized groups; address gaps in coverage and sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Develop and popularize participation charters
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and popularize Charters, specifying how, and when to participate, and the available opportunities for participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear, public charters guide citizens on participation channels and expectations, increasing transparency and predictability of processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Allocate adequate funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocate adequate funds for civic education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustainable financing is needed to avoid short-lived, project-driven NSA programmes that leave rural areas underserved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Enable NSAs operational environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an enabling environment that allows NSAs to support civic education programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitate partnership with NSAs through supportive policies, resource-sharing and coordination mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Promote participatory civic culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure civic education programs promotes a participatory culture driven by integrity, national values and principles of good governance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Civic education should inculcate norms and behaviours aligned with democratic participation and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Education — Continual and multi-level delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure an encompassing and continual civic education within and at all levels of government, including Constitutional offices and independent offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Civic education must be ongoing and institutionally integrated, not episodic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will undertake coordinated and integrated capacity building towards empowering responsible citizens, public institutions and NSAs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capacity building targets government agencies, NSAs and citizens for planning, managing, facilitating, documenting and M&E of participation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Develop capacity of lead institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop capacity of the institutions mandated to offer capacity building services to government agencies and NSAs on public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strengthen institutions such as Kenya School of Government and Centre for Parliamentary Studies to deliver practical skills, not only legal provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Recruit appropriate human resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage adequate human resources with appropriate skills and competencies to manage public participation functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staffing must include personnel skilled in stakeholder mapping, facilitation, documentation, analysis, communication and M&E.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Allocate budget for capacity building
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocate adequate budget for capacity building of all actors involved in public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding must be predictable and sufficient to ensure standardized training and tools across agencies and levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Collaborate in capacity building
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborate in capacity building on public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Government, NSAs and development partners should coordinate training efforts to avoid duplication and ensure coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Strengthen coordination mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish and strengthen coordination mechanisms in capacity building on public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardize approaches and tools across agencies to ensure uniform management of citizen engagement processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Protect NSAs operational environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote and safeguard NSAs operational environment for public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure NSAs can operate sustainably and contribute to civic education and engagement free from undue constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity Building — Embed MEL in capacity building
rubrics_metrics.description: Embed monitoring, evaluation and learning mechanisms in public participation processes as part of capacity building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should include M&E skills so that participation processes are documented, supervised and improved over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will promote effective public participation in planning, budgeting and implementation of approved plans and budgets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation at planning, budgeting and implementation stages fosters ownership and responsive development outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Integrate participation action plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate public participation action plans in all development plans, budgets and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation must be mainstreamed into planning and budgeting documents, not treated as ad hoc events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Provide adequate resourcing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide adequate resources for public participation in planning, budgeting and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budgets should cover advertising, civic education, logistics, documentation, and other essentials to enable meaningful engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Stakeholder mapping and engagement plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt and implement effective stakeholder mapping and engagement plans with sufficient stakeholder consultations in planning, budgeting and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid elite-only engagement; map and target stakeholders, including marginalized groups, to ensure representative consultations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Adequate notification and accessible information
rubrics_metrics.description: Prescribe for adequate notification of public participation, and provision of timely and accurate information in accessible formats for PWD’s and other citizens to facilitate meaningful public engagement in planning, budgeting and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notification and information must be timely, accurate, and provided in accessible languages and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Integrate environmental and social protection standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate national and international environmental and social protection standards in public participation during planning, budgeting and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation procedures should include consideration of environmental and social safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning, Budgeting and Implementation — Strengthen collaboration with partners and NSAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish or strengthen collaboration with development partners and Non-State Actors for effective cooperation and coordination of public participation in planning, budgeting and implementation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration reduces duplication and leverages complementary capacities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Minorities and Marginalised Groups — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will promote effective participation of minorities and marginalised groups at all levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This addresses constitutional mandates (Articles 53, 54, 55, 56, 57 and 100) to ensure groups like women, children, PWDs, youth, elderly, ethnic and other minorities have meaningful participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Provide guidelines for meaningful participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide guidelines for meaningful participation of minorities and Marginalised Groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidelines should spell out practical measures to ensure inclusion and reduce cultural, attitudinal and structural barriers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Stakeholder mapping to identify target groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Undertake stakeholder mapping to identify the minorities and marginalised groups for effective participation and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mapping ensures outreach targets those who are often excluded and tailors engagement approaches accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Planning for appropriate hours and venues
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure public participation processes have plans for engagement of the minorities and marginalised Groups, including provisions for appropriate hours, and venue for meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Logistics (timing, location, accessibility) must account for group-specific constraints (e.g., care obligations, mobility issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Tailored communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Tailor communication to meet the needs of minorities and marginalised groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use language, formats and channels appropriate to the target groups to improve comprehension and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Disability-friendly infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide disability friendly infrastructure for PWDs during public participation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure physical accessibility, sign language/alternate formats and other reasonable accommodations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion — Budgetary resources for engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide adequate budgetary resources for the engagement of minorities and marginalised groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allocate funds specifically to reach and support participation of marginalized groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will guarantee adequate, secure and sustainable funding for public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public participation is a governance value requiring protected and predictable funding to support infrastructure, logistics, civic education, M&E, feedback and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Provide funding guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide guidelines on funding for public participation to ensure adequate budgetary allocation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidelines should define minimal budgetary provisions, responsibility across levels, and permitted uses of funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Regular and continual funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide adequate funding for public participation on a regular and continual basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid one-off or unpredictable funding that undermines sustainable participation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Conditional grants to strengthen participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide conditional grants for strengthening of public participation to both levels of government and related agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditional grants can incentivize compliance with standards and support lower levels to implement participation obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Mechanisms for collaboration to source funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide mechanisms for collaboration with development partners and NSAs to facilitate sourcing of adequate funding for public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal collaboration mechanisms help supplement government funding without undermining sustainability or ownership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding — Fund K-NICE and existing frameworks
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide adequate funding for K-NICE and other existing frameworks for public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support national frameworks that coordinate civic education and participation to ensure standardized, nationwide coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will promote well-resourced updated and effectively implemented monitoring, evaluation and learning systems for public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MEL generates objective evidence, supports learning and ensures citizen inputs are tracked and considered in decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEL — Establish MEL systems and mechanisms for participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Put in place MEL systems and mechanisms for public participation in development projects and programmes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MEL should be integrated into project cycles and explicitly capture participation inputs, processes and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEL — Integrate participation in all MEL programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate public participation within every MEL program in Government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation indicators should be mainstreamed across MEL frameworks rather than treated separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEL — Publish and disseminate annual participation reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish and disseminate annual reports with indicators on the status of public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency of MEL outputs builds citizen confidence; reports must be accessible to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEL — Structured communication and feedback on MEL outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish structured communication and feedback mechanisms to ensure that MEL initiatives are disseminated to the citizens and policy makers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MEL outputs should feed back into policy and practice, and be communicated in understandable formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEL — Strengthen community participation in MEL
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen communities to actively participate in MEL, including auditing of public projects and programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community-level M&E and social auditing empowers citizens and increases accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and Reporting — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will promote responsive, functional and timely feedback and reporting mechanisms in order to build confidence in public participation process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback demonstrates how citizen inputs are used and is essential to sustain engagement and reduce apathy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and Reporting — Timely feedback mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish mechanisms for timely feedback and reporting on public participation at all levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback channels should be routinized, well-publicized and responsive to citizens' inputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and Reporting — Plans and implementation for feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Review, formulate and implement plans on feedback on public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions should have concrete plans and timelines for providing feedback after engagements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and Reporting — Guidelines for receiving and analysing feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that responsible institutions develop guidelines on receiving and analysing feedback from citizens, sharing and incorporation into development processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures should clarify how feedback is processed, who analyses it, and how it informs decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and Reporting — Reports must justify decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure reports provide justification for decisions made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports should explain how citizen inputs influenced outcomes or why certain inputs were not adopted, enhancing transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Policy Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The state will promote effective handling of complaints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complaints and redress are constitutional rights; multiple institutions (CAJ, KNCHR, NGEC, IPOA, NLC) exist but need effective decentralisation and resourcing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Simple, publicised and understandable mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish and strengthen complaints and redress mechanisms and procedures that are simple, available, publicised and understandable by users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mechanisms should be user-friendly and accessible at county and local levels; avoid complex procedures that deter complainants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Promote alternative dispute resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage ADR to complement formal complaint channels and provide accessible, faster redress options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Internal complaints mechanisms at all levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure internal complaints and redress mechanisms are established at all levels of government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public offices should institutionalize internal complaints handling focused on service improvement rather than only compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Strengthen oversight institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen oversight institutions on complaints handling at national and county levels of government, particularly Commission on Administrative Justice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide statutory clarity, decentralization, and resourcing to oversight bodies to enable effective redress services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Ensure compliance with laws and reporting mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure compliance with existing laws and complaints reporting mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public bodies must follow legal mandates and maintain reporting on complaints and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Sensitize citizens on mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitise citizens on complaints and redress mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awareness campaigns are essential so citizens know where and how to seek redress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints and Redress — Service delivery charters
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide for the development of a service delivery charter and ensure they are regularly reviewed and updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service charters set expectations for service standards, complaint handling procedures and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — Integrated, coordinated and consultative implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: The policy will be implemented through an integrated, coordinated and consultative process by various actors both at the national and county levels of government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementation must respect separation of powers and devolution and involve joint, collaborative management to ensure vertical and horizontal integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — Responsible coordinating office at each level
rubrics_metrics.description: At each and within each level there shall be a responsible office which will coordinate public participation and provide oversight in keeping with the principle of devolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designate clear coordinating units/offices at national and county levels to avoid fragmentation and ensure accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — Joint but separate management across levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Public participation will be managed separately, but jointly, collaboratively and in a consultative, cooperative and coordinated manner both at the national and county levels to ensure both vertical and horizontal integration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that while roles differ by level, coordination mechanisms must ensure coherence and complementarities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — National orientation and local language accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Appropriate strategies will be used to implement the policy. The strategies will take a national orientation and outlook. Public participation will take place at all levels including the lowest possible level of governance and will be conducted in English and Kiswahili in addition to other relevant languages commonly used in each specific locality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine national standards with local language and cultural adaptations to maximize reach and comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — National and County Civic Education Units engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: National and county Civic Education Units will ensure that public participation takes place in the most effective way inclusive of the lowest devolved units - village level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage CCEUs/units to operationalize civic education and participation at grassroots levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation — Regular review of strategies and action plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Public participation strategies and action plans will be reviewed regularly to address any emerging issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Periodic review ensures responsiveness to contextual changes and continuous improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: General — Address minimalism and compliance-only attitude
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy addresses the challenge of duty-bearers adopting a 'compliance only' or 'minimalist approach' that meets legal thresholds without effectively advancing public participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and implementation mechanisms should promote substantive, continuous engagement rather than tokenistic or one-off compliance exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: General — Remedy ineffective inclusion, logistics and communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy standards collectively aim to remedy ineffective inclusion of special interest groups, incoherent participation logistics, poor communication, and citizen apathy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operationalize stakeholder mapping, timely/appropriate communications, accessible logistics, civic education and feedback mechanisms to combat apathy and improve inclusion.
